introduction: Visible and infrared panels turn the Trifid Nebula into a direct comparison of what dust conceals and reveals.
observe: Find the dark dust lanes in the visible panel.
Then find the bright star-forming regions occupying corresponding areas in the infrared panels.
explanation: Spitzer's infrared observations reveal star-forming activity in regions that appear as dark lanes in the visible-light view.
colorMethod: The source identifies the Spitzer panels as false-color infrared views placed beside a visible-light image.
whyItMatters: The comparison shows why darkness in one wavelength does not mean absence of activity.
